Use case: illustration-story. Asset: 錢幣王牌, one illustration for the established Dragon Quest tarot deck.
Scene: Ace of Pentacles. Dragon Quest IX Stella, the small tan-skinned fairy with blonde curly hair, pink hair bow, orange bow-front dress, black stockings, black shoes with red bows and pink butterfly wings, hovers in a joyful relaxed upright pose above a sunny flowering garden path. ONE AND ONLY ONE large golden star-pentacle coin floats gently between her open hands at chest height, entirely visible and separated from her face. Green garden arch, white lilies, rolling blue-green hills and a castle in the distance; a hopeful new practical opportunity. Wholesome fairy adventure illustration, outfit fully retained as in the character reference. Do not copy the gallery heading.
Draw a single new continuous full-bleed 2:3 portrait illustration for the approved Dragon Quest tarot deck. Reference 1 supplies character identity/outfit only; reference 2 supplies approved deck ink, cel-color and paper texture only, not a scene or person to copy. Faithful recognizable Dragon Quest character design, confident black ink contours, crisp painted cel-color blocks, restrained shading and subtle watercolor-paper grain, bright rich countryside colors. Large readable figure and clearly visible separate gold circular pentacles with embossed five-point stars. No typography, titles, numbers, logos, watermark, UI or card border. Ignore all lettering and background framing in the reference image. No extra coins, currency or gold disc ornaments.
visual_review: Stella recognizable blonde curls/pink bow/orange dress/black stockings/red-bow shoes/pink butterfly wings. Exactly one large star pentacle fully visible. Approved deck ink/cel-color texture, no text or frame.
